mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_sanctions (user_id, post_id, post_title, comment_id, comment_content, admin_reason, sanction_type, suspended_until) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, #{postTitle}, #{commentId}, #{commentContent}, #{adminReason}, #{sanctionType}, #{suspendedUntil})
mapper.select: SELECT sanction_id, user_id, post_id, post_title, comment_id, comment_content, admin_reason, sanction_type, suspended_until, created_at FROM user_sanctions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
